restPoseCurvature.note: measured on the generation's own centreline before anything was carried; this animal has no neck to measure separately

mouth.method: aimed by hand in the viewer's mouth editor (docs/triassic/mouths/hybodus-mouth.json); the modelled slit -- found by casting every head vertex's own normal back into the mesh -- is measured beside it and no longer cuts

restingGape.verdict: the generation arrived GAPING: the bind pose carries that gape, closing it for the locomotion clips is a large jaw rotation, and this animal wants a mouth-closed regeneration

howCurvedTheMouthLineIs.note: how far the measured lip line departs from a straight line. A fish mouth is often genuinely straight and this is the easy case -- but the cut follows the measured curve either way, so the number below is what the cut costs and this one is only how much work the curve was doing.

cutDeviationFromTheMeasuredLipLine.note: the cut is the aimed plane now, read on the mouth's measured centre; this is how far that plane stands from the mid height of the slit the generation modelled, over the stations the slit was measured at (aimedCut.perStation has every one).

generationsOwnDentition.note: kept as generated and weighted to the jaw they grow from; nothing is authored here

teethOnTheCut.note: patches of oral surface standing proud of their own neighbourhood by more than the dentition threshold, and which side of the aimed cut each vertex of them is on. A patch on both is a tooth the plane crosses: its tip rides one bone and its root the other, and the caps close each piece.

mouth.closure: the cut's own rim: T.cap_cut over the hinge wall on each half, then T.cap_mouth along the mouth line on each half, domed into it (dome 0.30, ceiling 0.55 of the head's own room either side of the mouth line). No lining, no hinge plug, no rim fold and no seam seal.

aimedCut.note: Cut on. The file hash-matched the shipped body it was aimed on; rebuilding on it is what consuming it looks like, so npm run triassic:mouth now refuses it on the hash, and the frame is asserted against the bounding box the document measured instead.

jawField.construction: T.jaw_field_aimed: one jaw share over both halves of the head, a function of position in the aimed document's frame, continuous everywhere except across the cut plane ahead of the hinge wall

Hybodus authored body.construction: one share over both halves (T.jaw_field_aimed), continuous except across the aimed cut

Hybodus procedural volume twin.construction: one share over both halves (T.jaw_field_aimed), continuous except across the aimed cut

sweep.note: T.jaw_field_aimed swept over its ramp width (fraction of the body; the fade behind the hinge is twice it). Each row is a full rebuild on 04ee6af plus this builder, measured on the build's own GLB: the builder's jaw-weight steps ("does not break": the largest jump in jaw weight along an edge of the skin the body arrived with, and the same over the two kinds of fill), skin-tears.mjs, lag.mjs, and mandible-travel.mjs --profile (the mandible mesh only, in fifths from the hinge to the front of the mouth, at each clip's peak). Ships at 0.035: the widest ramp -- so the smallest step -- at which every fifth of the tooth row still travels at least 0.95 of its bone at Bite, the widest gape; 0.05 bows the rear of the jaw to 0.91 at Bite and 0.75 at Eat, 0.07 to 0.84 and 0.64 and takes the front with it. Skin and the jaw cut are the same at every width.

weightRelaxation.note: each pass replaces a vertex's weights with this much of its own and the rest shared equally among its neighbours on the mesh graph

jawShutFromTheGenerationsPartedPose.note: the mandible posed at the measured closing rotation, against the skull's own surface in the same pose. Anything above zero is the generation's two tooth rows, modelled apart, meeting for the first time.

pairedFinSweptAngleInSprint.note: total absolute change in each paired-fin root's Euler angles over the whole Sprint clip, which holds two tail beats. These are control surfaces and take no propulsive stroke, but they sweep with the beat rather than hanging.

gapeSolid.note: Measured 27 September 2026 (T3D-39) on the body cut on docs/triassic/mouths/hybodus-mouth.json and closed by its own rim, over every clip whose jaw leaves the shut pose: the eight that open past neutral at their own peak gape, the seven that only stir it, and the three legacy phases T3D-32A recorded its before-numbers at (Heavy@0.4, Bite@0.133, Attack@0.333). The body carries no oral mesh, so plain, --as-drawn and --as-drawn --show lining|hinge render the same geometry and agree shot for shot. "before" is the T3D-36 body (the labelled cut, rim fold, seam seal and two rigid shells) re-measured on 04ee6af.

oralMeshOutsideTheShutHead.method: T3D-38's cheek check: every oral mesh painted an emissive marker, the body at Idle frame 0 (jaw shut), photographed from four units off both flanks and from above; marker pixels counted.
